method: RGB-only region-wise bidirectional monotone multi-quantile luma alignment and mild mean-chroma correction toward one active-female baseline from fixed six-image snapshots; continuous smooth anatomical blending. Both overly bright and overly dark inputs converge. No image geometry, alpha or new texture is generated.
protections: Every alpha byte and canvas coordinate retained
Rear hair y<=190 RGB retained, transition190..235
Front02 near-matching chest quantiles retained within6 luma units
preview_layout: Six columns: front01,front02,front03,back01,back02,back03. Top before; bottom after.
limitations: Targets are anatomy-region distributions, not pixel-identical shading certification.
Spatial blending and ornament protection can leave output quantiles away from the nominal target; both are measured explicitly.
Female02 low-bun nape/curtain are excluded from comparable long-hair target.
No synthetic fine strand texture is added; residual texture differences are recorded by highpass/gradient metrics.
High-frequency metrics vary with strand width and direction and are not a standalone art pass.
